meta.costs: 3 bps per unit one-way turnover (sum over sleeves |dw|) unless stated; 10/15 bps = UCITS-route sensitivity
meta.tranche: mean of the 5 weekday books' daily net returns (main_tranche_check.py); each weekday has at most one executing book, so this equals netted-turnover accounting
meta.trade_threshold: a sleeve trades when |change in held weight| > 1e-06
meta.cross_market_calendar: all markets on the panel (US/NDX) trading calendar; foreign closes forward-filled

variant_count.note: each variant = one weight rule on one basis for one market (cost sensitivities and windows of the same variant are not counted again); bisection/linear solves touch exposure only, never returns. Tags 'NDX-*-rematch-*' and 'cross-market-3x-info' are information-only and never enter a decision; 'cross-market' includes the ndx_sim2x reference row (excluded from the median)

summary.rule: RETAINED if tranche dCalmar >= +0.03 in both halves AND cross-market median >= +0.02; REPLACEABLE if < +0.03 in at least one half AND median <= +0.02; else INCONCLUSIVE (retain by default)
